label: def:categorical-jet
title: Categorical jet object
html:
Definition. Categorical jet object

A jet object packages an element of A together with its infinitesimal variation along the connection. Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a quantum universe with connection \nabla (categorical connection). The jet object is

  J^1(A) := A \otimes_{\mathbf{C}} \Omega^1(A),

where \Omega^1(A) = \ker(\mu \colon A \otimes A \to A) is the bimodule of Kähler differentials. The jet object fits into the universal extension

\begin{equation}\label{eq:jet-ses}
\begin{tikzcd}[column sep=2.5em]
  0 \ar[r]
  & A \otimes \Omega^1(A) \ar[r]
  & J^1(A) \ar[r, "j^1"]
  & A \ar[r]
  & 0
\end{tikzcd}
\end{equation}

where j^1 \colon J^1(A) \to A is the jet evaluation.
